BanHit.description: BanHit is a driving ban the trip runs into.

ban.description: Ban names the rule: the days and hours it holds and for which trucks.

certain.description: Certain: the trip is in the country while the ban is in force, by its passage times. Otherwise it may be: no departure time was given, the holiday is regional, or the leg crosses several countries and Sootcase didn't say in which order.

country.description: Country is where the ban holds (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2).

exemptions.description: Exemptions are the law's exemptions, in short (perishable goods, combined transport, ...): the truck may have one.

from.description: From and To are the ban's window, local time (RFC 3339).

holiday.description: Holiday names the public holiday it is for, and Regions where it is kept only in some regions.

law.description: Law is the law that sets the ban; sources links it.

listed.description: Note says where or for whom else the ban holds; Listed, that it holds only on the roads it names (Roads, their refs).

note.description: Note says where or for whom else the ban holds; Listed, that it holds only on the roads it names (Roads, their refs).

regions.description: Holiday names the public holiday it is for, and Regions where it is kept only in some regions.

roads.description: Note says where or for whom else the ban holds; Listed, that it holds only on the roads it names (Roads, their refs).

to.description: From and To are the ban's window, local time (RFC 3339).

wait_h.description: WaitH is how long the truck waits for the ban to end, where Certain.

BatchItem.description: BatchItem is one trip's result, or why it couldn't be priced.

error.description: Error says why the trip wasn't priced.

result.description: Result is the priced trip, as POST /v1/carbon-cost answers it.

BatchRequest.description: BatchRequest is several trips to price (POST /v1/carbon-cost/batch).

trips.description: Trips are priced each on its own, as POST /v1/carbon-cost would; at most 100.

BatchResponse.description: BatchResponse holds the trips' results in the order asked.

results.description: Results are the trips' results, in the order of the request's.

Comparison.description: Comparison is the trip priced for a truck in another CO2 class.

carbon_eur.description: TollEUR is its road tolls, TotalEUR all its charges and CarbonEUR their carbon part.

co2_class.description: CO2Class is the truck's CO2 emission class (1 to 5).

energy_eur.description: EnergyEUR is its diesel or electricity, WithFuelEUR the charges and it (Response.WithFuelEUR), and SavingWithFuelEUR what it saves with the energy counted: null where either truck's energy has no price.

road_toll_eur.description: TollEUR is its road tolls, TotalEUR all its charges and CarbonEUR their carbon part.

saving_eur.description: SavingEUR is what this truck saves per trip against the requested one (negative: it costs more).

saving_with_fuel_eur.description: EnergyEUR is its diesel or electricity, WithFuelEUR the charges and it (Response.WithFuelEUR), and SavingWithFuelEUR what it saves with the energy counted: null where either truck's energy has no price.

total_eur.description: TollEUR is its road tolls, TotalEUR all its charges and CarbonEUR their carbon part.

with_fuel_eur.description: EnergyEUR is its diesel or electricity, WithFuelEUR the charges and it (Response.WithFuelEUR), and SavingWithFuelEUR what it saves with the energy counted: null where either truck's energy has no price.

ElectricityCost.description: ElectricityCost is an electric truck's energy for the trip at the price given, without VAT.

basis.description: KWh is the electricity the trip takes, and Basis how it was worked out (electricity_kwh, or kwh_per_100km times the road km).

eur.description: EUR is the electricity's cost, without VAT.

eur_per_kwh.description: EURPerKWh is its price without VAT.

kwh.description: KWh is the electricity the trip takes, and Basis how it was worked out (electricity_kwh, or kwh_per_100km times the road km).

price.description: Price says where the price comes from: "given", or Eurostat's average for businesses where the trip runs.

error.description: What was wrong, naming the field.

FuelBought.description: FuelBought is the litres bought in one country and their price.

country.description: Country is where the litres are bought, and Litres how many.

eur.description: EURPerL is their price per litre without VAT (after any refund), and EUR the litres' cost; none where there is no price.

eur_per_l.description: EURPerL is their price per litre without VAT (after any refund), and EUR the litres' cost; none where there is no price.

litres.description: Country is where the litres are bought, and Litres how many.

price.description: Price says where the price comes from: "given", or "Weekly Oil Bulletin <date>".

refund.description: RefundEURPerL is the refund of the excise per litre (diesel_refunds), and Refund the law it rests on.

refund_eur_per_l.description: RefundEURPerL is the refund of the excise per litre (diesel_refunds), and Refund the law it rests on.

FuelCost.description: FuelCost is the trip's road diesel at a price: the truck's running cost, not a charge.

by_country.description: ByCountry is where the litres are bought (fuel_purchases, fuel_country, or along the route by road km) and their price.

complete.description: Complete is false when some litres have no price (bought outside the EU without a price given); Unpriced lists those countries.

eur.description: EUR is the litres priced, at their prices, without VAT.

in_price_eur.description: InPriceEUR is the CO2 prices on fuel (and, from 2028, ETS2) of the litres priced: the diesel price already holds them, so with_fuel_eur leaves them out of the charges.

refund_eur.description: RefundEUR is the hauliers' partial refunds of the excise on the litres bought where the law sets one (diesel_refunds); EUR is after them.

unpriced.description: Complete is false when some litres have no price (bought outside the EU without a price given); Unpriced lists those countries.

FuelPurchase.description: FuelPurchase is fuel bought for the trip in a country, for the national CO2 prices on fuel, which are paid where it is bought.

litres.description: Litres is the diesel bought there.

InCurrency.description: InCurrency is the trip's amounts in another currency (Request.Currency), at the rate the charges in that currency are converted at: fx given, the ERM II central rate for DKK, else the ECB's reference rate of the trip's date (a national central bank's for RSD and ALL).

carbon.description: Total, Carbon, WithFuel and TripCost are total_eur, carbon_eur, with_fuel_eur and trip_cost_eur in the currency.

currency.description: Currency is the request's currency, PerEUR its units per euro, and Rate where that rate comes from (the ECB's of the day, a central bank's, or given in fx).

per_eur.description: Currency is the request's currency, PerEUR its units per euro, and Rate where that rate comes from (the ECB's of the day, a central bank's, or given in fx).

rate.description: Currency is the request's currency, PerEUR its units per euro, and Rate where that rate comes from (the ECB's of the day, a central bank's, or given in fx).

total.description: Total, Carbon, WithFuel and TripCost are total_eur, carbon_eur, with_fuel_eur and trip_cost_eur in the currency.

trip_cost.description: Total, Carbon, WithFuel and TripCost are total_eur, carbon_eur, with_fuel_eur and trip_cost_eur in the currency.

with_fuel.description: Total, Carbon, WithFuel and TripCost are total_eur, carbon_eur, with_fuel_eur and trip_cost_eur in the currency.

amount.description: Amount is the charge in Currency, the rate table's, and AmountEUR in euros: at the request's fx, DKK at the ERM II central rate, else at the day's ECB reference rate (the central bank's for RSD and ALL).

amount_eur.description: Amount is the charge in Currency, the rate table's, and AmountEUR in euros: at the request's fx, DKK at the ERM II central rate, else at the day's ECB reference rate (the central bank's for RSD and ALL).

area.description: suburban or interurban, where rates differ by it

charge.description: Charge is its kind: road_toll, ferry_ets, ferry_uk_ets, ets2, fuel_co2, area_charge or ferry_fare.

component.description: Component is the charge's part by law: infrastructure, co2, air, noise, air_noise, env_zone_surcharge, km_charge (Belgium's per-km charge), rail_surcharge (Slovenia's), distance_fee (the LSVA of Switzerland and Liechtenstein), or toll where the law sets one rate with no split.

country.description: Country is where it is paid (none for a ferry's ETS).

currency.description: Amount is the charge in Currency, the rate table's, and AmountEUR in euros: at the request's fx, DKK at the ERM II central rate, else at the day's ECB reference rate (the central bank's for RSD and ALL).

days.description: Days is the days a time-based charge is paid for.

km.description: Km is the km it is charged on, and TonnesCO2 the emissions a charge on CO2 is charged on.

rate.description: Rate is the rate applied, in RateUnit.

road.description: motorway or other, where rates differ by road

section.description: a fixed-charge section or a surcharged stretch

source.description: Source is the law and table the rate comes from, and how the amount was worked out.

sources.description: Sources link the documents the line's rate comes from.

t_co2e.description: Km is the km it is charged on, and TonnesCO2 the emissions a charge on CO2 is charged on.

tonnes.description: chargeable weight, for rates per tonne-km

Missing.description: Missing is a charge the trip meets that the result leaves out.

area.description: Area is the country, or region, of the charge.

charge.description: Charge is the kind of charge: road_toll, ferry_fare, area_charge or fuel_co2.

ended.description: Ended is the last day of the last rates here; Starts, for "before_table", the first day of the first.

reason.description: Reason is "no_table" (this tool has none for the area), "ended" (its rates ended on Ended and the next ones aren't here yet; also when the trip reaches the charge after that day), "no_route" (its tolls are at stations or on sections, and the trip was given as country_km), "needs_truck_field" (it goes by a truck field the request doesn't give; the notes name it), "unpriced" (the table has no price for this use, such as an entry and exit it doesn't pair; the notes say which) or "before_table" (its first rates here start on Starts, after the trip's day: an earlier price isn't here).

starts.description: Ended is the last day of the last rates here; Starts, for "before_table", the first day of the first.

Provenance.description: Provenance is what a result was calculated from: enough to repeat it.

assumed.description: Assumed lists defaults taken where the request didn't say.

ferry_mrv.description: FerryMRV is the EU MRV publication a ferry crossing's emissions come from.

fx.description: FX is the exchange rates used.

road_classes_osm.description: RoadClasses is the OpenStreetMap extract date of the road classes used, by country.

sootcase.description: Sootcase is the Sootcase server and its emission factor dataset.

sootcase_basis.description: SootcaseBasis is the standard, framework and version Sootcase says its emissions follow, and SootcaseCertification its statement on Regulation (EU) 2026/1030.

sootcase_certification.description: SootcaseBasis is the standard, framework and version Sootcase says its emissions follow, and SootcaseCertification its statement on Regulation (EU) 2026/1030.

tables.description: Tables are the rate tables priced, with their data files.

RatesSource.description: Source is a document the rates come from.

title.description: Title names the document (a law, a table, a dataset), and URL is where it is published.

url.description: Title names the document (a law, a table, a dataset), and URL is where it is published.

RatesTruck.description: Truck is what a toll rate depends on.

adr_tunnel_code.description: HeightM, WidthM, AxleLoadKg, Hazmat and ADRTunnelCode (B, C, D or E, the load's tunnel restriction code under ADR 1.9.5; it implies Hazmat) are optional: with any of them, the route keeps to roads the truck may drive (Sootcase's vehicle), its length and weight too.

axle_load_kg.description: HeightM, WidthM, AxleLoadKg, Hazmat and ADRTunnelCode (B, C, D or E, the load's tunnel restriction code under ADR 1.9.5; it implies Hazmat) are optional: with any of them, the route keeps to roads the truck may drive (Sootcase's vehicle), its length and weight too.

axles.description: of the truck with its trailer

capacity_kg.description: CapacityKg is the load capacity (permissible mass less the mass in running order) a ferry charges by, optional: the semi-trailer's for a tractor with semi-trailer, else the truck's and its trailer's together. Croatia's state ferries charge goods vehicles with more than 5 t of it a fare per tonne of it.

hazmat.description: HeightM, WidthM, AxleLoadKg, Hazmat and ADRTunnelCode (B, C, D or E, the load's tunnel restriction code under ADR 1.9.5; it implies Hazmat) are optional: with any of them, the route keeps to roads the truck may drive (Sootcase's vehicle), its length and weight too.

height_m.description: HeightM, WidthM, AxleLoadKg, Hazmat and ADRTunnelCode (B, C, D or E, the load's tunnel restriction code under ADR 1.9.5; it implies Hazmat) are optional: with any of them, the route keeps to roads the truck may drive (Sootcase's vehicle), its length and weight too.

length_m.description: LengthM is the vehicle's length with trailer, optional: bridge tolls are priced by length (default DefaultLengthM).

motor_axles.description: MotorAxles is the motor vehicle's own axles, optional: Lithuania's charge counts those (a tractor's, without the semi-trailer's).

motor_mass_kg.description: MotorMassKg and TrailerMassKg are the motor vehicle's and the trailer's own technically permissible maximum mass, optional: Iceland's km fee charges each vehicle of a combination on its own. They need MotorAxles.

tare_kg.description: TareKg is the truck's own weight (with trailer), optional: ferries report freight emissions per tonne of vehicle and cargo.

trailer_mass_kg.description: MotorMassKg and TrailerMassKg are the motor vehicle's and the trailer's own technically permissible maximum mass, optional: Iceland's km fee charges each vehicle of a combination on its own. They need MotorAxles.

width_m.description: HeightM, WidthM, AxleLoadKg, Hazmat and ADRTunnelCode (B, C, D or E, the load's tunnel restriction code under ADR 1.9.5; it implies Hazmat) are optional: with any of them, the route keeps to roads the truck may drive (Sootcase's vehicle), its length and weight too.

Request.description: Request is a trip to price.

alternatives.description: Alternatives asks Sootcase for up to this many routes of each leg (2 to 5; Sootcase v0.14.0): each is priced in full, and routes lists them. On a trip with stops, an alternative is one leg's other route, the rest as Sootcase routes them.

avg_speed_kmh.description: AvgSpeedKmh is the average speed for those times, default DefaultAvgSpeedKmh.

cargo_kg.description: CargoKg is the cargo when the trip carries one shipment from start to end (otherwise give shipments).

compare_co2_classes.description: CompareCO2Classes prices the same trip for trucks in these CO2 classes (e.g. [1, 4, 5]), otherwise the same as Truck.

cost_share_by.description: CostShareBy is what the shipments' shares of the costs are weighed by, per km of each one's own route: "tkm" (the default: tonnes), "loading_m" or "pallets" (their loading_m or pallets). Emissions are shared by tonne-km whatever it is.

country_km.description: CountryKm prices a trip with no route: the km driven in each country (or region, ISO 3166-2, where tolls differ by region), from a tachograph, say. Only charges by the km and by the day are priced; tolls at stations and on sections need a route, and the result lists them as missing; bridges, tunnels, ferries and zones aren't priced (a note says so). Not with from, to, stops, shipments or path.

currency.description: Currency (ISO 4217, e.g. DKK, PLN, SEK) adds the totals in that currency (in_currency), at the rate its charges are converted at.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; default today where the trip starts (CET if not known)

diesel_eur_per_l.description: DieselEURPerL is what the truck pays for diesel, EUR per litre without VAT, wherever it fills up; DieselEURPerLByCountry by country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), over it. Without them, the EU's Weekly Oil Bulletin's national averages of the trip's week. The fuel cost is a line of its own: total_eur stays the charges, and with_fuel_eur adds the fuel.

diesel_eur_per_l_by_country.description: DieselEURPerL is what the truck pays for diesel, EUR per litre without VAT, wherever it fills up; DieselEURPerLByCountry by country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), over it. Without them, the EU's Weekly Oil Bulletin's national averages of the trip's week. The fuel cost is a line of its own: total_eur stays the charges, and with_fuel_eur adds the fuel.

diesel_l.description: DieselL is the litres of diesel the truck burns on the trip's road part, for the CO2 prices on fuel and ETS2.

diesel_refunds.description: DieselRefunds takes off the diesel the partial refund of the excise that some countries pay road hauliers on the litres bought there (FR, IT, ES, HU, HR and SI from 7.5 t, PT from 35 t; fuel.Refunds). Give diesel prices before it.

dkk_per_eur.description: DKKPerEUR converts DKK to EUR; default DKKPerEUR.

driver_eur_per_h.description: DriverEURPerH and VehicleEURPerKm are the truck's own running costs: the driver per hour of driving (Trip.Hours; put paid breaks and allowances in the rate) and the vehicle per road km (tyres, maintenance, depreciation). With either, trip_cost_eur adds them to with_fuel_eur, and route "cheapest" compares by it.

driver_rest.description: DriverRest adds a single driver's breaks and daily rests to those times (Regulation (EC) No 561/2006, Arts. 7 and 8): 45 minutes after 4.5 hours' driving, 11 hours after 9.

electricity_eur_per_kwh.description: An electric truck's (CO2 class 5) energy: ElectricityKWh used on the trip (from rFMS totalElectricEnergyUsed or charging records), or KWhPer100Km over the road km; ElectricityEURPerKWh is what it pays per kWh without VAT (blank: Eurostat's average for businesses where it charges). KWhPer100Km also prices the electricity of a class 5 truck in the comparison.

electricity_kwh.description: An electric truck's (CO2 class 5) energy: ElectricityKWh used on the trip (from rFMS totalElectricEnergyUsed or charging records), or KWhPer100Km over the road km; ElectricityEURPerKWh is what it pays per kWh without VAT (blank: Eurostat's average for businesses where it charges). KWhPer100Km also prices the electricity of a class 5 truck in the comparison.

env_zone_km.description: EnvZoneKm is km driven on tolled roads inside environmental zones, by country (Denmark charges a surcharge there).

etc.description: ETC: the truck pays tolls by an electronic toll device or account agreement, for the operators' discounts and tag or account prices where they publish them (Croatia's ENC, Storebælt's Grøn rabat, ØresundBUSINESS and others).

ets2_eur_per_t.description: ETS2EurPerT is the ETS2 allowance price (EUR per t CO2e), for trips from 2028. 0: ETS2 is not priced.

eua_eur_per_t.description: EUAEurPerT is the EU ETS allowance price (EUR per t CO2e), for ferry crossings. 0: ferry ETS is not priced.

ferry.description: Ferry "avoid" routes the trip on land only.

ferry_ets_basis.description: FerryETSBasis is how a ferry's EU ETS is priced: by default the surcharge its line publishes per metre of the vehicle, where the crossing has one line that does (DFDS, Scandlines, Stena Line, POLSCA: what the truck is charged), else the cargo's share of the ships' emissions at eua_eur_per_t; "emissions" always prices the latter.

ferry_ets_share.description: FerryETSShare is the share of a crossing's emissions under the EU ETS for a crossing this tool doesn't know: 1 between two EU/EEA ports (default), 0.5 to or from a port outside. A known crossing's share comes from its ports, its ships' size and the derogations in force.

from.description: From and To are where the trip starts and ends, for a trip with no stops between; give Stops instead for one with.

fuel_country.description: FuelCountry is where the trip's road fuel is bought (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), for national CO2 prices on fuel. "": bought along the route, each country's share in proportion to its road km.

fuel_purchases.description: FuelPurchases are the fuel bought for the trip, by country: the national CO2 prices on fuel go by where it was bought, and the litres are the trip's diesel unless diesel_l or l_per_100km is given.

fx.description: FX converts other currencies to EUR, in units per euro, e.g. {"CHF": 0.93}; default the ECB reference rates (Calculator.FX).

kwh_per_100km.description: An electric truck's (CO2 class 5) energy: ElectricityKWh used on the trip (from rFMS totalElectricEnergyUsed or charging records), or KWhPer100Km over the road km; ElectricityEURPerKWh is what it pays per kWh without VAT (blank: Eurostat's average for businesses where it charges). KWhPer100Km also prices the electricity of a class 5 truck in the comparison.

l_per_100km.description: LPer100Km is the truck's diesel consumption, litres per 100 km, when diesel_l isn't given. Without either the default for its vehicle group and load is used (Trip.FuelBasis says which).

motorway_share.description: MotorwayShare is the share of an area's tolled km on motorways (default 0), where its rates differ by road type (Brussels).

night.description: Night: the trip passes night-tariff sections between 22:00 and 05:00 (Austria's A 13 Brenner).

path.description: Path is the way the truck drove (or will), [lon, lat] points from a GPS track or telematics: its tolls, crossings and km by country are priced on it instead of Sootcase's route. Sootcase still routes the stops for the shipments' emissions and ferry crossings.

route.description: Route is the route priced: "primary" (Sootcase's, the default), "cheapest" (of the routes, the one with the lowest with_fuel_eur, or total_eur where a diesel price is missing, complete ones first), or a route's id from routes (e.g. "alt1"; "leg2:alt1" on a trip with stops). Without alternatives, cheapest asks for 3 routes and an id for 5.

shipments.description: Shipments are the trip's cargo, each from its loading stop to its unloading stop; the result gives each one's share of the trip. Without them cargo_kg is one shipment from the first stop to the last. Put a groupage trip's other cargo in as shipments too, or the one given carries the whole trip.

stops.description: Stops are the trip's stops in order: where the truck starts, where it loads or unloads, where it ends (a depot it returns to empty, say).

time.description: Time is the local departure time (HH:MM) on Date. Each toll station is reached that much later as its km along the route take at AvgSpeedKmh; that time prices congestion taxes and the hours a toll system or station is free. Without it congestion taxes aren't priced and hours aren't checked.

to.description: From and To are where the trip starts and ends, for a trip with no stops between; give Stops instead for one with.

tolled_share.description: TolledShare is the share of each country's km on tolled roads: default the road classes read from OpenStreetMap where the tool has them (roads/data), else 1 (all of it). Give it to override.

trips_per_year.description: TripsPerYear turns the comparison's savings per trip into savings per year.

truck.description: Truck is the truck the tolls are priced for.

uka_gbp_per_t.description: UKAGbpPerT is the UK ETS allowance price (GBP per t CO2e), for crossings between UK ports from 1 July 2026. 0: not priced.

vehicle_eur_per_km.description: DriverEURPerH and VehicleEURPerKm are the truck's own running costs: the driver per hour of driving (Trip.Hours; put paid breaks and allowances in the rate) and the vehicle per road km (tyres, maintenance, depreciation). With either, trip_cost_eur adds them to with_fuel_eur, and route "cheapest" compares by it.

vehicle_type.description: VehicleType is Sootcase's vehicle type for the emissions; default DefaultVehicleType, or ElectricVehicleType for CO2 class 5.

bans.description: Bans are the driving bans the trip runs into (package bans).

carbon_eur.description: the CO2 parts of tolls, ferry ETS, national CO2 prices on fuel and ETS2

carbon_eur_per_tkm.description: EURPerTkm and CarbonEURPerTkm are the trip's amounts per tonne-km of its shipments: each shipment's rate, as they are shared by tonne-km.

certification.description: Certification says the tool isn't certified under Regulation (EU) 2026/1030: only certified tools on the Commission's list may say their results are calculated in accordance with it (Art. 10(1), 11), and carbon-cost never does.

compare.description: Compare is the trip priced for each of CompareCO2Classes.

complete.description: Complete says whether the total includes every charge this tool knows the trip meets; false when Missing lists any.

country_km.description: CountryKm is the km by country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), and RegionKm by region (ISO 3166-2) where tolls are set by region.

data_type.description: DataType is "primary" (the truck's diesel given) or "modelled" (Sootcase's defaults, or the default diesel of the truck's group).

date.description: Date is the day priced (YYYY-MM-DD): the request's, or today.

distance_km.description: DistanceKm is the trip's km, FerryKm the part on ferries.

driver_eur.description: DriverEUR and VehicleEUR are the running costs at the rates given; TripCostEUR is with_fuel_eur (total_eur without a diesel price) and them.

electricity.description: Electricity is an electric truck's energy at the price given.

emissions_basis.description: EmissionsBasis says how TTWKg and WTWKg were found.

eur_per_tkm.description: EURPerTkm and CarbonEURPerTkm are the trip's amounts per tonne-km of its shipments: each shipment's rate, as they are shared by tonne-km.

ferry_crossing.description: FerryCrossing names the crossings the route uses, when recognised.

ferry_km.description: DistanceKm is the trip's km, FerryKm the part on ferries.

fuel.description: Fuel is the trip's diesel at the price given, or the Weekly Oil Bulletin's: not a charge, so not in total_eur.

in_currency.description: InCurrency is the totals in Request.Currency.

intensity_g_co2e_per_tkm.description: IntensityG is the well-to-wheel g CO2e per tonne-km of the shipments: EN ISO 14083's emission intensity.

lines.description: Lines are the charges, one per charge, country and part.

missing.description: Missing lists the charges the trip meets that the total leaves out: areas with no table here, and rates that ended with no successor here yet (a new year's tariffs not yet published or added).

no_rates.description: NoRates lists countries on the route this tool has no toll table for: their charges are not included.

notes.description: Notes say what the result rests on and what it leaves out.

provenance.description: Provenance names the data and assumptions the result rests on.

region_km.description: CountryKm is the km by country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), and RegionKm by region (ISO 3166-2) where tolls are set by region.

route.description: Route is the route split by country, for a map (Calculate with Borders set).

routes.description: Routes are the routes priced, when alternatives were asked for: each one's charges and the difference from Sootcase's primary route; the one this answer prices is chosen.

shipments.description: Shipments are each shipment's share of the trip's charges, by tonne-km (EN ISO 14083:2023), or by cost_share_by; its emissions are always by tonne-km. The totals are the truck's.

sources.description: Sources are the laws and data the result uses, each once.

total_eur.description: TotalEUR is the charges' sum, in euros.

trip.description: Trip is the truck's trip: legs, loads and diesel.

trip_cost_eur.description: DriverEUR and VehicleEUR are the running costs at the rates given; TripCostEUR is with_fuel_eur (total_eur without a diesel price) and them.

ttw_kg.description: TTWKg and WTWKg are the trip's greenhouse gas emissions, kg CO2e, tank-to-wheel and well-to-wheel: from the truck's own diesel when it is given (primary data, which Regulation (EU) 2026/1030 puts first), else Sootcase's (GLEC default intensities x the tonne-km, modelled).

vehicle_eur.description: DriverEUR and VehicleEUR are the running costs at the rates given; TripCostEUR is with_fuel_eur (total_eur without a diesel price) and them.

with_fuel_eur.description: WithFuelEUR is total_eur and the truck's energy (the diesel or the electricity), without counting twice the CO2 prices on fuel (and ETS2) that the diesel price already holds.

wtw_kg.description: TTWKg and WTWKg are the trip's greenhouse gas emissions, kg CO2e, tank-to-wheel and well-to-wheel: from the truck's own diesel when it is given (primary data, which Regulation (EU) 2026/1030 puts first), else Sootcase's (GLEC default intensities x the tonne-km, modelled).

RouteOption.description: RouteOption is one route of the trip, priced: Sootcase's primary or one of its alternatives.

carbon_eur.description: TotalEUR and CarbonEUR are its charges and their carbon part (Response.TotalEUR, Response.CarbonEUR).

chosen.description: Chosen is the route this answer prices.

distance_km.description: DistanceKm, FerryKm and CountryKm are the route's km, its km on ferries, and its km by country.

error.description: Error says why it couldn't be priced.

ferries.description: Roads and Ferries tell it apart: its main roads (OSM refs) and the ferries it takes, as Sootcase names them.

ferry_km.description: DistanceKm, FerryKm and CountryKm are the route's km, its km on ferries, and its km by country.

hours.description: Hours is the trip's driving time on it (Trip.Hours).

roads.description: Roads and Ferries tell it apart: its main roads (OSM refs) and the ferries it takes, as Sootcase names them.

with_fuel_eur.description: WithFuelEUR is the charges and the diesel (Response.WithFuelEUR); TripCostEUR adds the running costs given.

Run.description: Run is a stretch of the route in one country (Kind "road"), on a recognised ferry crossing (Kind "ferry") or at sea (Kind "sea", more than borders.NearestKm from any coast), for a map. Consecutive runs share their end point.

country.description: Kind is "road", "ferry" or "sea"; Country is the road run's.

kind.description: Kind is "road", "ferry" or "sea"; Country is the road run's.

Shipment.description: Shipment is cargo on the trip: loaded at one stop and unloaded at a later one. The truck pays the trip's charges; each shipment's share of them is its tonne-km over all the shipments' (EN ISO 14083:2023, the method of Regulation (EU) 2026/1030, CountEmissionsEU).

from.description: From is the stop it is loaded at, 0 being the first.

id.description: ID names it in the result; default its number, from 1.

loading_m.description: LoadingM and Pallets are the loading metres and pallet places it takes, for sharing the costs by them (cost_share_by).

pallets.description: LoadingM and Pallets are the loading metres and pallet places it takes, for sharing the costs by them (cost_share_by).

to.description: To is the stop it is unloaded at; 0 means the last.

ShipmentCost.description: ShipmentCost is a shipment's share of the trip.

by_charge.description: ByCharge is its share of each kind of charge, in EUR.

by_country.description: ByCountry is its share of the charges of each country (a line's country: where a toll or tax is paid; a ferry's ETS, paid to no country, under its charge), in EUR: what an invoice passing the tolls on by country needs.

carbon_eur.description: TotalEUR and CarbonEUR are its share of the charges and of their carbon part (by Request.CostShareBy).

carbon_eur_per_100kg.description: EURPer100Kg and CarbonEURPer100Kg are its amounts per 100 kg, as surcharges are quoted.

distance_km.description: DistanceKm is its transport activity distance: the road route from its loading stop to its unloading stop (EN ISO 14083's shortest feasible distance), not the truck's way between them.

eur_per_100kg.description: EURPer100Kg and CarbonEURPer100Kg are its amounts per 100 kg, as surcharges are quoted.

from.description: From and To are its loading and unloading stops, by index in the trip's stops (0: from).

fuel_eur.description: FuelEUR, WithFuelEUR and TripCostEUR are its Share of the trip's fuel, with_fuel_eur and trip_cost_eur.

id.description: ID is the shipment's (Shipment.ID), or its number from 1.

intensity_g_co2e_per_tkm.description: IntensityG is its well-to-wheel g CO2e per tonne-km.

share.description: Share is its share of the trip's costs: its tonne-km over all the shipments', or its loading metres or pallet places times its DistanceKm over theirs (Request.CostShareBy).

tkm.description: TKm is its tonne-km: WeightKg / 1000 x DistanceKm.

to.description: From and To are its loading and unloading stops, by index in the trip's stops (0: from).

total_eur.description: TotalEUR and CarbonEUR are its share of the charges and of their carbon part (by Request.CostShareBy).

trip_cost_eur.description: FuelEUR, WithFuelEUR and TripCostEUR are its Share of the trip's fuel, with_fuel_eur and trip_cost_eur.

ttw_kg.description: TTWKg and WTWKg are its emissions, kg CO2e: its tonne-km share of the truck's diesel plus its share by weight of the ferries it is on, when the diesel is given; else Sootcase's (GLEC default intensity x its tonne-km).

with_fuel_eur.description: FuelEUR, WithFuelEUR and TripCostEUR are its Share of the trip's fuel, with_fuel_eur and trip_cost_eur.

wtw_kg.description: TTWKg and WTWKg are its emissions, kg CO2e: its tonne-km share of the truck's diesel plus its share by weight of the ferries it is on, when the diesel is given; else Sootcase's (GLEC default intensity x its tonne-km).

elapsed_h.description: Hours is the trip's driving time: Sootcase's at truck speeds (ferries included) where it gives it, else the road km at avg_speed_kmh; HoursBasis says which. ElapsedH, with driver_rest, adds a single driver's breaks and daily rests (Regulation (EC) No 561/2006, Arts. 6-8).

hours_basis.description: Hours is the trip's driving time: Sootcase's at truck speeds (ferries included) where it gives it, else the road km at avg_speed_kmh; HoursBasis says which. ElapsedH, with driver_rest, adds a single driver's breaks and daily rests (Regulation (EC) No 561/2006, Arts. 6-8).

post.description: The CSV calc -csv takes: a header naming calc's flags without the dash (from, to, via, date, cargo-kg, mass-kg, axles, euro, co2-class, shipments, l-per-100km, fuel-bought, country-km, ...), a trip a row. Other columns are kept as labels (listed in the X-CSV-Labels header); path, rfms, vin, csv, json and sootcase can't be set here. The rows come back with the results' columns added (trip_date, distance_km, total_eur, carbon_eur, ..., eur_by_country, ..., tkm, wtw_kg, ttw_kg, g_co2e_per_tkm, data_type, complete, missing, error). With rows=shipments a trip with shipments gives a row per shipment (shipment_id, shipment_kg, and the shipment's share of the amounts, tonne-km and CO2e).

parameters.description: trips (the default): a row per trip; shipments: a row per shipment of a trip that has them.

post.description: Takes a CSV priced by POST /v1/carbon-cost/csv (or calc -csv) and adds its rows up by the columns in by: any column of the file (a label such as customer, or shipment_id) and month or year (of trip_date). Each group: rows, shipments, km, empty km, litres, tonne-km, CO2e well-to-wheel and tank-to-wheel, the charges, g CO2e per tonne-km, EUR per tonne-km, EUR per 100 kg carried (in all, of tolls, of carbon), the share of tonne-km priced on primary data, and the rows that are incomplete or failed.

parameters.description: Columns to group by, separated by commas (e.g. customer,month); blank: one total.
